external_storage_audit.gap_criticality: HIGH — Restoring ecosonic.db without storage/ directory produces database records pointing to non-existent WAV and NPY files.

recommended_full_backup_procedure.step_1: Perform atomic SQLite online backup: sqlite3 ecosonic.db 'VACUUM INTO "backup/ecosonic.db"'
recommended_full_backup_procedure.step_2: Perform atomic filesystem snapshot/rsync of backend/storage/ (live_audio, audio, embeddings)
recommended_full_backup_procedure.step_3: Perform atomic copy of .model_cache/ and FAISS/HNSW index files
recommended_full_backup_procedure.step_4: Verify SHA256 checksums across db and storage manifests
